tried: The fetch tool reads only the first 120,000 characters of this 11 MB PDF; it was read whole in a browser tab on dco.uscg.mil with pdf.js.
notes: Edition: COMDTINST M16130.2F (2013), as the task names. Page correction for the task text: Table H-7a is on p. H-26 (before H-7), not H-30; H-7 spans H-28 and H-29 and continues onto H-30 for further classes not needed here. H.3.4.7 says H-7 was modified from Allen and Plourde 1999 for operational use: intercepts rounded to 0.01 kts, divergence angles are the 1999 maxima divided by 1.35 and rounded up, and a standard-error column added. So H-7 and the 1999 Table 8-1 values differ by design and must be kept side by side. Figures are as printed; the percentage in each scope is the printed slope x 100, stated for readability. Rows cover every class the task lists (PIW vertical/sitting/horizontal; 4-6 person rafts with and without drogue; skiffs; sea kayak; surfboard) plus the class means printed on the same rows of the table. low and high are left null on purpose: these are coefficients, not counts.
